meeting_time_note: No fixed weekly meeting time. Weekly topics are self-paced; SmartBook/Quiz/Reading Assignments generally open Monday and close Friday 11:45pm. Exams are on fixed dates with 2-day windows.
notes: Required text: Biology, The Essentials, 4th Ed. (Hoefnagels) with Connect. Grading: Exams 55% (4 exams, 15% wait -- see syllabus for exact breakdown), Quizzes 15%, SmartBooks 15%, Participation 15%. IMPORTANT: this course's academic integrity policy explicitly prohibits using AI tools to generate, edit, paraphrase, or construct written responses for assignments, discussions, quizzes, or exams - violations are treated as academic dishonesty. This restriction applies to Biology coursework itself, not to using a personal tool to track due dates.
